newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-UK's Guinness, Grand Met downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-UK's Guinness, Grand Met downgraded.

text.p: Guinness Plc and its planned merger partner Grand Metropolitan Plc were downgraded by Lehman Brothers, the investment bank said on Thursday.
Guinness was cut to "neutral" from "outperform" while Grand Met was cut to "underperform" from "outperform," a Lehman said in a research note.
Analyst John Wakely said there was "increasing downside" seen to the merger and that antitrust problems and French legal problems had been understated.
Sterling strength was another continuing negative factor, he argued, and since most of the financial community was already positive there was little upside for the two shares.
However the note did not refer to the different ratings given to the two groups and Wakely was not immediately available for comment.
